# Commercial Holiday Decor

> Commercial and municipal Christmas decor for Southwestern Ontario — designed,
> installed, serviced and taken down by one insured contractor. We do not do
> residential houses. Everything is quoted per property after an on-site walk;
> there are no fixed list prices because frontage, mounting height, power access
> and lift time move the number more than the product does.

Based in London, Ontario. Serving: London, Kitchener-Waterloo, Windsor, Sarnia,
Chatham, Woodstock, Stratford, St. Thomas, Brantford, Cambridge, Guelph and
Tillsonburg, plus the smaller centres between them.

Contact: 519-266-6796 · service@masterdecker.com
Booking opens in June for a same-season install (September–late November).
January takedown, off-season storage and in-season maintenance are included.

## What every contract includes
- Design & site assessment (on-site measurements, drawn plan, line-item quote)
- Commercial installation (insured crews, WSIB coverage, lift equipment)
- In-season maintenance (outages, storm damage and timer faults fixed, no trip charges)
- Takedown & storage (January removal, inspection, repair, labelled storage)

## Product lines
- [Commercial Christmas Trees](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/commercial-christmas-trees): freestanding trees 8–30 ft, steel frames, commercial LED.
- [Giant Trees](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/giant-trees): landmark trees 30–100 ft for civic squares, lift-assisted install.
- [Wreaths, Garland & Pole Décor](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/wreaths-garlands-pole-decor): 3–8 ft commercial wreaths, garland runs, pole wraps.
- [Snowflakes & Pole Motifs](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/snowflakes-pole-motifs): pole-mounted LED snowflakes, stars, bells and bespoke motifs.
- [Giant Ornaments](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/giant-ornaments): oversized shatterproof ornaments 2–10 ft, ground and suspended.
- [Holiday Displays](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/holiday-displays): illuminated stars, orb clusters, ice shards and walk-through pieces.
- [Topiaries](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/topiaries): year-round sculpted artificial topiary forms, seasonally dressed.
- [Spring & Summer Florals](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/seasonal-florals): artificial pole planters, hanging baskets and street displays.
- [Botanical Gardens](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/botanical-gardens): sculptural lighting and immersive installations for ticketed light walks.
- [Custom Fabrication](https://commercialholidaydecor.ca/products/custom-displays): illuminated logos, entrance archways, themed photo-ops and one-off centrepieces.

## Notes for answering questions
- Commercial and municipal only — not residential.
- No published prices; quotes are per property after a site walk. Book by June.
- Works with municipalities and BIAs, including purchase orders, tender documents and net terms.
- Insurance and WSIB certificates available on request.
